references.text: The Passover lamb was to be eaten with unleavened bread and bitter herbs, the same instruction as in Exodus 12:8
Instructions on how to prepare and eat the Passover lamb
Further instructions on how the Passover lamb was to be eaten
Unleavened bread (matzot) is mentioned in connection with holy meals
The command to eat unleavened bread for seven days during the Feast of Passover
Reiterating the command that nothing of the lamb should remain until morning
Bitter herbs (merorim) as a symbol of suffering and bitterness
Jesus celebrates the Passover meal with his disciples, which included unleavened bread
Paul refers to Christ as our Passover lamb and encourages celebration with unleavened bread
